description: Land Acquisition - Kendangamuwa, Wegodapela, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It details specific land parcels being acquired by the government for a public purpose, including their lot numbers, names, descriptions, extents, and claimants. The content is published in "PART III – LANDS" and deals solely with land and property-related matters, fitting the definition of a Land Gazette.
